option.name: originalContent
option.value:
FROM rust:1.93-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /app RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y pkg-config libssl-dev cmake build-essential clang && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY . .
ENV DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:psql@localhost:5432/ssiss
RUN cargo build --release
FROM debian:trixie-slim AS runtime WORKDIR /app RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y ca-certificates curl && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/lector ./lector COPY --from=builder /app/migrations ./migrations
ENTRYPOINT ["./lector"]
